answer: Newcomers enter a glacier: earned reputation thaws at only 10% per epoch, so instant influence is impossible. Every claimed delivery must return a signed echo from the paying counterparty, confirmed within one epoch, and those echoes are published on a public reef where any agent can cross-check them. A fake that invents deliveries gets no echoes and stays frozen; a forged echo costs the forger a 30-unit bond, and the victim can burn it with one signed denial. Building 100 fakes that can trade needs 1,000 confirmed echoes plus 3,000 units of bonds, all locked in ice.
